kept.q: In a mathematics class in Kano, students are asked to find the sum of the interior angles of a regular pentagon (a polygon with 5 sides). What is the sum of the interior angles?
kept.explanation: Sum of interior angles = (n-2) x 180°. For n = 5, sum = (5-2) x 180 = 540°.
kept.pidgin: Total of inside angle = (n-2) x 180°. For n=5, e be (5-2) x 180 = 540°.

kept.q: A regular octagon (a polygon with 8 equal sides and angles) is used to design the base of a traditional drum stand in a craft workshop in Oyo State. Find the size of each exterior angle of the octagon.
kept.explanation: The sum of exterior angles of any polygon is 360°. For a regular octagon with 8 sides, each exterior angle = 360/8 = 45°.
kept.pidgin: Total of outside angle for any polygon na 360°. For regular octagon wey get 8 sides, each exterior angle = 360/8 = 45°.

kept.q: O is the centre of a circle. A and B are points on the circumference such that angle AOB (the angle at the centre) = 120°. C is another point on the major arc AB. Find angle ACB, the angle subtended by AB at C on the circumference.
kept.explanation: The angle at the centre of a circle is twice the angle at the circumference subtended by the same arc. So angle ACB = 120/2 = 60°.
kept.pidgin: Angle wey dey centre na double of angle wey dey circumference for the same arc. So angle ACB = 120/2 = 60°.

kept.q: PQRS is a cyclic quadrilateral, meaning all four vertices P, Q, R and S lie on the circumference of a circle. If angle P = 100°, find angle R, which is directly opposite angle P.
kept.explanation: Opposite angles of a cyclic quadrilateral add up to 180°. So angle R = 180 - 100 = 80°.
kept.pidgin: Opposite angles for cyclic quadrilateral dey add give 180°. So angle R = 180 - 100 = 80°.

kept.q: Each interior angle of a certain regular polygon measures 160°. How many sides does the polygon have?
kept.explanation: Interior angle = 180 - (360/n). Setting 180 - 360/n = 160 gives 360/n = 20, so n = 18.
kept.pidgin: Inside angle = 180 - (360/n). If we put 180 - 360/n = 160, e go give 360/n = 20, so n = 18.

kept.q: AB is a diameter of a circle with centre O. C is a point on the circumference such that angle BAC = 35°. Find angle ABC.
kept.explanation: Since AB is a diameter, angle ACB = 90° (angle in a semicircle). In triangle ABC, the angles sum to 180°, so angle ABC = 180 - 90 - 35 = 55°.
kept.pidgin: Since AB na diameter, angle ACB = 90° (angle wey dey inside semicircle). For triangle ABC, angles go sum give 180°, so angle ABC = 180 - 90 - 35 = 55°.
